valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E. Earnings period priced at the Nov 2027 target date is FY2028 (year to Jan 2028), non-GAAP diluted EPS, about 0.93B diluted shares (Q2 FY27 non-GAAP net income $865.9M / EPS $0.94 = 0.92B). Standalone Marvell: the pending all-stock Lumentum deal ($115B, closing uncertain, $3.2B reverse termination fee per Cantor) is excluded and is the main unmodelled risk. Anchors: Q2 FY27 revenue $2.739B; Q3 guide $3.15B +/-5%, non-GAAP EPS $1.10 (about 32% net margin); company-raised FY27 revenue about $12B and FY28 about $18B (Zacks report, secondary). Non-GAAP excludes stock compensation, which flatters EPS.

bear.driver: Custom-silicon ramp slips, FY28 revenue $15B, gross margin pressure

base.driver: FY28 revenue near $18B guide, net margin about 32%

bull.driver: FY28 revenue $20B, net margin 34%, AI demand sustained

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $6.20 the close implies 25.3x; the sampled named targets (average about $233) imply 37.6x or EPS $7.77 at 30x
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.20 (4.0 pp)
valuation.watch_metric: Non-GAAP gross margin and data center revenue growth against the Q3 guide of 57.5-58.5% and $3.15B total revenue, plus Lumentum deal approval status
valuation.next_disclosure: Q3 FY2027 earnings, around Dec 1, 2026 (per aggregator listing, unconfirmed)

analyst_notes: Named views found are all after the Lumentum all-stock deal (early Nov 2026): TD Cowen cut to $175 and Hold, RBC to $250 (Outperform), B. Riley to $275, each citing deal dilution and integration. The base case sits below RBC and B. Riley mainly through a lower multiple (30x vs implied 37x+ at the same EPS) rather than EPS. Only three firms were found with dated calls, and no brokers' 12-month horizons were documented, so none enter the weighted target. Aggregator consensus (about $317) predates or ignores many cuts and is stale.
